I'm directing a new play for a local theater group, and I'd like to make 20 copies of the script this play will be performing.
Do you have the author's permission to reproduce it?
I actually wrote it myself.
See?
Here's my ID.
Okay.
It'll be 10 cents per page.
Now, how about the binding?
We can do staples at no extra charge, or we have some upgraded options.
What about spiral binding?
Sure.
If you use the coupon in our mobile application, it's only $2 extra per script.
I have the app right here on my smartphone.
Number 15.

你是否有作者的许可来复制它？
我其实自己写的。
看？
这是我的证件。
好的。
每页是10美分。
那装订呢？
我们可以免费用订书钉，或者我们有一些升级的选项。
螺旋装订怎么样？
当然可以。
如果你使用我们手机应用中的优惠券，每份剧本只需要多付2美元。
